thefundamentals: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Changes this weapon's damage type, cycling between Void, Arc, and Solar. Grants this weapon temporarily increased damage when you apply or gain an elemental buff or debuff that matches this weapon's damage type.

p.d: Sliding collects nearby ammo and temporarily grants enhanced reload speed and handling to your weapons.
Dealing damage with your weapons temporarily grants enhanced sliding. Sliding provides damage resistance.
Final blows with area-of-effect damage, Solar abilities, Seventh Seraph weapons, or IKELOS weapons grant Warmind Charges. Each stack of Warmind Charge increases your Weapons and Grenade stats.

While you have Warmind Charges, defeating powerful combatants, destroying a construct, or destroying a Tangle releases a Solar detonation that damages combatants and heals allies.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

You deal significantly increased Kinetic damage to combatant shields, overshields, vehicles, and constructs. Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
Defeating powerful combatants or breaking a combatant shield with Kinetic damage releases a disorienting Kinetic shockwave.
Final blows on Guardians and powerful combatants generate additional ammo progress.
After a final blow on a powerful combatant, the next time your shields are broken, you become invisible.
As your health gets lower, your weapons gain increased stability and handling. Weapon final blows while your shields are depleted heal you.
When your shields become broken, you gain increased ammo generation, flinch resistance, and damage resistance against nearby combatants for a short time. Final blows extend this effect.
Your health begins regenerating immediately after taking melee damage from a powerful combatant.
Gain stacks of Siphoning Touch for weapon or Glaive melee hits. Switching weapons heals you and consumes all stacks.
Taking significant damage in a short time generates a Protective Wish that makes it harder for combatants to hit you, and grants increased reload speed and flinch resistance.

When the Protective Wish expires, it cures you. 

Rapid final blows prematurely end the Protective Wish.
While amplified, your Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Heat weapons gain increased handling, reload, and vent speeds.
Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.

Being near allies creates a relay network that gives the wearer improved handling and reload speed. 

Being near other allied Network Admins additionally grants the wearer a bonus to Health stat.
Weapon final blows grant the wearer and nearby allies melee energy.
Grenade final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage.
Grenade final blows grant additional Heavy ammo progress.
After picking up an Orb of Power, the next time your shields are broken, gain a bonus to Health stat for a short duration and release a burst of radiolaria around you.
While you have a subclass buff, dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

When an ally is defeated, Primary ammo weapons gain increased handling, reload speed, target acquisition, and reduced flinch. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.
Final blows with Primary ammo weapons remove you from radar for a short time. Drawing a weapon that does not use Primary ammo will immediately end this effect.
Powered melees release an additional disorienting pulse when used to defeat a target.
When your shields are broken by a combatant, or upon casting your Super, release a swarm of heat seeking micro-missiles.
Final blows with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile temporarily decrease incoming area-of-effect damage.
When Force Absorption is active, taking melee damage causes you to emit a disorienting burst once.
Picking up an ammo brick gives you a stacking bonus to weapon swap and stow speeds until you die.
Suspend, unravel, and sever effects applied to targets, and radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.
Final blows with freshly drawn or reloaded weapons heal you.
Bow, Shotgun, or Sword final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage. Damaging targets with those weapons extends the effect.
After a final blow with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile, sprint for a short time to gain Speed Booster.
Once per activation of Force Converter, sprinting while at critical health, being suspended, or being slowed by a Stasis effect will immediately grant Speed Booster for a short duration.
Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher. When you finish a target, release a slowing burst around you.
Gain increasing damage resistance when you deal damage or land final blows. Finishers grant accelerated progress. At max stacks, the recharge rate of your abilities is also increased.
Performing a finisher stores power. The next time your shields are broken, consume stored power to immediately heal and start health regeneration.
While you have Radiant, Restoration, or Cure, your melee hits release a burst that will scorch the target.

Final blows with Light weapons grants stacks of Light Polarity, which grants Grenade stat. Final blows with Darkness or Kinetic weapons grants stacks of Dark Polarity, which grants stacks of Melee stat.

Final blows with Light weapons grants additional grenade energy. Final blows with Dark or Kinetic weapons grants additional melee energy. Rapid final blows that alternate between Light and Darkness grant a short period of damage resistance.

Picking up ammo, Orbs of Power, Elemental pickups, or destroying a Strand Tangle grants stacks of Untold Greed, slightly reducing damage taken and providing reload speed to equipped weapons. When your shields are broken, some stacks are lost.

While you have stacks of Untold Greed, Orbs of Power and Elemental pickups provide more of their respective energy, and Strand Tangles deal increased damage. When your shields are broken, all stacks are converted into a fountain of Orbs of Power.
Stowing a weapon after defeating a powerful combatant or a Guardian heals you a small amount and disorients nearby combatants.

Freshly drawn weapons deal increased precision damage to combatants for a short period. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait equipped or Exotics manufactured by the Tex Mechanica Foundry gain further increased benefits.
Taking damage increases the reload speed of your equipped weapon until it is stowed. Taking more damage increases the effect.
When you stow a weapon, restore health based on the number of Built Bitter stacks lost.
Finishing combatants or reviving allies initiates a Lucent Hive ritual. While the ritual is active, gain increased Super stat.
Collecting Orbs of Power extends the Ceremony. While it is active, ability final blows occasionally spawn allied Arc moths.
Defeating targets with unique elemental damage grants a stacking bonus to Transcendence energy gains while Transcendence is inactive.
While Transcendence is active, using your grenade ability consumes all stacks of Stack 'Em Up to grant an escalating amount of grenade energy.
Hitting combatants with melee attacks or Sword strikes grants a stack of Initiative, giving bonus handling and reload. Stacks decay slowly over time.
While you have Initiative, using your class ability creates a stationary healing aura. The aura gains increased healing based on the number of Initiative stacks.
Increases handling and reload speed for Primary ammo weapons. Primary ammo weapons gain increased damage against non-boss combatants based on your Weapons stat.
Final blows while your Super is active refund Super energy when it ends.
Sprinting for a short time grants a period of improved reload speed and handling. Final blows extend this period.
While Adrenal Rush is active, final blows grant Special Ammo progress. Final Blows against powerful combatants, Guardians, and Taken grants additional progress.
Fast movement builds up a charge that gradually increases your health regeneration speed. Once you are Fully Revved, sprinting grants Speed Booster.
Sliding while Speed Booster is active jolts combatants in front of you.
Primary ammo weapons gain a bonus to flinch resistance after sliding.
Your weapons gain a temporary increase to handling and aim-down-sights speed when an ally is defeated or you revive an ally.
Final blows with grenades grant Heat weapons bonus stability and vent speed and grant Primary ammo weapons bonus stability and reload speed.
Multiple final blows with Heat weapons or Primary ammo weapons grant bonuses to weapon and grenade stats and increased ammo generation for Heat weapons and Primary ammo weapons.
Final blows to a challenging combatant or higher-ranked target grant Unstable Essence. When you have Unstable Essence, you receive grenade and melee stat bonuses.
When you have Unstable Essence, rapid weapon damage or final blows heal you and begin health regeneration.
Gain increased reload speed for the bottom half of your equipped weapon's magazine.
Reloading a weapon grants it a bonus to handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time. Weapons with the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait are granted increased range instead.
Picking up ammo grants Armor Charge. Grants a bonus to Health stat per Armor Charge you have.
Sustained damage on minibosses, Champions, and bosses increases weapon damage versus base and powerful combatants. Weapon final blows consume one stack each.

Damaging a target with a Sword, Glaive, or any melee attack exhausts them. 

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
Blocking attacks with a Sword or Glaive grants a short period of damage resistance against targets when you next drop your guard.
Picking up ammo reloads stowed Special weapons from reserves.
After dealing damage with your Super, health and shields regenerate over time while you are in motion. Additional Super damage refreshes this effect.
Rapidly defeating combatants with Void energy spawns a Void breach.
After collecting a Void breach, your next final blow with a Void weapon triggers a detonation. The detonation is more powerful if it is triggered quickly after collecting a Void breach.
Performing a finisher on a combatant, or landing successive powered melee final blows, generates an Elemental pickup based on your Light subclass.
Performing a finisher on powerful combatants heals you and generates loyal Void moths.
Precision final blows while aiming down sights grant damage resistance until you stop aiming down sights.

Precision final blows with any weapon grant a stacking bonus to reload speed, target acquisition, and weapon damage against non-boss combatants for a short duration.

Weapon final blows with non-precision direct hits end this effect early.
Final blows versus subclass-debuffed targets have an escalating chance to spawn an Orb of Power.
Performing a finisher versus a powerful combatant grants Devour. While you have Devour, gain damage resistance versus combatants.
Primary ammo weapon final blows grant a stacking bonus to mobility and Primary weapon range and handling until you are defeated.
Increases mobility and grants enhanced sprint speed and slide distance.
Melee final blows trigger a Cursed Thrall explosion.
Being in combat for a duration grants progressively more flinch resistance and damage resistance versus combatants.
Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.
While you have Stable Resonance, continued weapon damage occasionally generates a resonance burst that damages and exhausts targets.
When you pick up an Orb of Power, gain a brief period of rapidly decaying damage reduction.
Defeating a powerful combatant with a finisher grants you Special ammo progress and replenishes a small amount of health.
Swapping to a Heat weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon grants a short period of increased handling and accuracy. This effect is extended by dealing damage with that weapon.

Dealing final blows while Reflex Action is active grants a bonus to weapon stat and increases stability, reload, and aim assist for Heat weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons for a moderate duration.
Reloading an Auto Rifle, Scout Rifle, or Sidearm after a final blow slowly restores health until you reenter combat.
When you reach critical health or heal an ally at critical health, Auto Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms gain a period of increased range, stability, and reload speed.
After being out of combat for a moderate duration, your next final blow grants additional ammo progress and creates an Orb of Power.
After being out of combat for a moderate duration, slowly gain Frost Armor until you reenter combat.
When your shields become broken, collect all nearby Orbs of Power and ammo bricks.

Whenever you gain, lose, or spend an Armor Charge, heal and gain damage reduction for a short time.

This effect scales with the amount of Armor Charge gained, lost, or spent.
Final blows with primary ammo weapons grant your primary ammo weapons temporarily increased reload speed.
Picking up an Orb of Power grants Special ammo progress.
Picking up an ammo brick heals you.
Final blows with Primary ammo weapons grant you briefly increased radar resolution.
Activating your grenade or the Nanotech Tracer Missiles Origin Trait provides stacking resistance to incoming damage at point-blank range.
Defeating an unraveled combatant grants grenade ability energy. If you have max grenade energy, you are granted Special ammo meter progress instead.
Primary ammo weapons deal increased damage to disoriented combatants.
Your grenade abilities release an additional disorienting pulse shortly after detonating.
Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.
For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.
When your shields begin to regenerate, you gain flinch resistance and damage resistance for a short time.

While your reserves are low, combatant final blows with weapons provide additional ammo progress based on their ammo type.  Primary ammo weapons boost Special ammo progress, and Special ammo weapons boost Heavy ammo progress.
Receiving healing temporarily grants your Solar weapons increased flinch resistance, handling, and reload speed.
Rapid Solar final blows heal you.
Sword hits return grenade and class energy. Bonus energy is granted if Blade Focus is active.
Briefly guard with a Sword to ready Blade Focus. While Blade Focus is readied, hitting a target with your sword increases Sword damage and lunge distance for a moderate duration.

super.d:
[Super]  : Create two woven blades and roam the battlefield. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Perform a leaping slash towards nearby targets, severing them on hit and dealing bonus damage to suspended targets. Each successful hit briefly increases your attack speed and grants energy for your heavy attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Unleash a heavy upward slash, creating two suspending projectiles that seek out targets.

classAbility.d: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.

movement.d: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.
Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.

melee.d: Activate your charged melee ability to dash forward, slashing at targets in front of you and severing them.

grenade.d: A grenade that bounces and releases multiple whirling threads, severing targets.

Weave a grappling hook, and quickly pull yourself forward. Grappling to a Tangle immediately recharges your grenade energy.

During and shortly after grappling, your melee attack deals area damage and unravels targets.
A thrown weapon of weighted Strand matter that detonates on impact, suspending targets and creating additional suspending subprojectiles.
A woven projectile that reweaves itself into Threadlings while in flight.

aspects.d:
Activate your Barricade ability to create a ripple in reality that travels forward along the ground, suspending and damaging the targets it hits.

Final blows on targets affected by Suspend, Unravel, or Sever grant class ability energy.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.

Destroying a Tangle or casting your Super grants Woven Mail for nearby allies.

While you have Woven Mail, your melee regeneration rate is increased.

Defeat a target with a melee attack, finisher, or Sword to raise a Banner of War that pulses with energy, periodically healing nearby allies and increasing melee and Sword damage. 

Targets defeated by you and nearby allies charge the banner, increasing the speed of its pulses.

While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to leap into the air, knocking nearby targets away and dealing damage.

While airborne, activate your charged melee again to launch a cluster of damaging, unraveling projectiles. Repeatedly activating melee will chain additional throws.

fragments.d: Super final blows emit a suspending burst from the target.
Landing rapid precision hits emits a severing burst from the target.
Suspend, unravel, and sever effects applied to targets have increased duration.
Dealing damage generates grenade energy.
Powered melee final blows grant your [Strand] Strand weapons Unraveling Rounds.
Threadlings travel farther and deal additional damage.
Activating your grenade ability reloads your equipped weapon and grants bonus airborne effectiveness and handling for a short duration.
Finisher final blows create Threadlings.
Defeating suspended targets grants class ability energy.
Damaging targets with a Tangle grants melee energy.
[Strand] Strand weapon final blows have a chance to create a Threadling.
While you have Woven Mail, weapon final blows create a Tangle.
Picking up an Orb of Power grants Woven Mail.
Defeating suspended targets creates an Orb of Power.

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your gauntlet down to create a shockwave that freezes targets and sends out [Stasis] Stasis crystals to freeze additional ones.

[Light Attack]  : Supercharge your Shiver Strike for bonus damage. Sprint through [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets to shatter them instantly.

Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.

melee.d: Hold input to leap through the air. Releasing unleashes a powerful dash attack that knocks targets back and attaches a delayed Stasis explosive to them.

grenade.d: A grenade that shatters on impact, leaving behind a field that slows targets and freezes those who do not leave the volume.
A grenade that creates walls out of [Stasis] Stasis crystals to block damage and freeze targets; these walls can be shattered for damage.

A grenade that sticks to combatants before exploding into razor-sharp [Stasis] Stasis shrapnel. The shrapnel ricochets off surfaces, dealing damage to all in its path. Hitting a frozen target shatters it instantly and deals bonus damage.
A grenade that freezes on impact and sends another seeker to find and freeze targets.

aspects.d:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to launch a wave of [Stasis] Stasis energy forward that freezes enemy combatants, slows enemy players, and creates [Stasis] Stasis crystals.

Grants an additional melee charge.

Picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards grants stacks of Frost Armor.

While you have Frost Armor, defeating combatants with Stasis or Kinetic weapons may cause them to shatter, damaging other nearby combatants. The shatter chance increases with your Frost Armor stacks.

Taking damage while you have Frost Armor generates melee energy.
Your slide distance is greatly increased. Sliding releases a wave that shatters [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets on contact, along with any other frozen targets nearby.

Shatter or defeat targets with [Stasis] Stasis abilities or weapons to create a Stasis lance.

[Shoot]  : Throw the lance to freeze targets on impact.

[Melee]  : Slam the lance to the ground to freeze targets in a small area.

fragments.d: Defeating targets while you have Frost Armor has a chance to create a [Stasis] Stasis shard.
You gain grenade energy each time you take damage from targets. Having Frost Armor increases the amount of energy gained.
Shattering a frozen target with a melee attack grants a stack of Frost Armor.
Damaging targets with a [Stasis] Stasis melee reloads your weapons and grants you a temporary boost to weapon ready speed.
While you have Frost Armor, melee damage slows your target.
[Stasis] Stasis weapon final blows have a chance to create a Stasis Shard.
Primary ammo weapons do increased damage to [Stasis] Stasis crystals and frozen targets.
Nearby [Stasis] Stasis shards track to your position.
Your Frost Armor has increased duration and maximum stack count.
Increases the melee energy gained from picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards.
Defeating slowed or frozen targets grants you class ability energy.
Slow that you apply to targets lasts longer. For those abilities that linger, their duration will also increase.
Increases weapon handling and health after freezing a target with [Stasis] Stasis.
Increases the damage and size of the burst of [Stasis] Stasis when you destroy a [Stasis] Stasis crystal or defeat a frozen target.
Defeating frozen targets generates an Orb of Power.
Shattering a [Stasis] Stasis crystal temporarily boosts your grenade recharge rate. Shattering additional [Stasis] Stasis crystals increases the duration of this benefit.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.

Summon a flaming hammer and wreak destruction down upon your enemies.

[Light Attack]  : Throw your hammer at foes.

Hold input to leap through the air. Releasing unleashes a powerful dash attack that knocks targets back and attaches a delayed Stasis explosive to them.

After sprinting for a short time, use this melee ability to swing a blazing hammer that scorches your target and deals damage in a cone behind them.

If your target is defeated by Hammer Strike, they ignite.

[Melee] : Hold while grounded to plant your feet and begin charging your fist with Arc energy.

[Melee] : Release to unleash a devastating blast in front of you, dealing damage that increases with longer charge time.
Activate your charged melee ability to dash forward, slashing at targets in front of you and severing them.

grenade.d: A grenade that creates walls out of [Stasis] Stasis crystals to block damage and freeze targets; these walls can be shattered for damage.
A grenade that periodically damages targets within its explosion radius.
A thrown weapon of weighted Strand matter that detonates on impact, suspending targets and creating additional suspending subprojectiles.
A grenade that sends forth a burning line of fire, dealing damage and scorching targets in its path.
An explosive grenade that suppresses, preventing targets from using abilities for a short time.

[Grenade]  : Throw an explosive device energized with [Strand] Strand matter and [Arc] Arc energy that detonates in a supercharged suspending burst. The suspended target takes heavy damage over time and chains jolting lightning to any nearby targets.

aspects.d:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to launch a wave of [Solar] Solar energy forward, damaging and scorching targets in front of you as you leap into the air.

While airborne, activate your charged melee again to slam to the ground and create a second larger wave of damaging [Solar] Solar energy. If the wave hits a scorched target, they ignite.

[Grenade]  : Hold to summon a [Void] Void shield that draws hostile fire and blocks a portion of incoming damage, gradually draining your grenade energy and granting an Overshield over time.

Releasing the grenade input or running out of energy releases a frontal blast from your shield that disorients combatants and deals increased damage based on how much damage was blocked. Final blows with the frontal blast grant you Devour.

Combatants that come in contact with your shield are temporarily disoriented.

Shatter or defeat targets with abilities or [Stasis] Stasis weapons to create a Stasis lance.

[Shoot]  : Throw the lance to freeze targets on impact.

[Melee]  : Slam the lance to the ground to freeze targets in a small area.

Critically wounding a target or breaking their shield infuses your melee attacks with Arc energy and increases your melee range against combatants and melee damage against combatants and Guardians for a short time.

Defeating targets with melee attacks makes you amplified and restores a portion of your health. Defeating more powerful combatants increases the amount of health restored.

Activate your Barricade ability to create a ripple in reality that travels forward along the ground, suspending and damaging the targets it hits.

Final blows on targets affected by Suspend, Unravel, or Sever grant class ability energy.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.

fragments.d: Finishers create a detonation that either jolts, scorches, slows, severs, or makes targets volatile based on the damage type of your equipped Super.
Melee final blows start health regeneration. While transcendent, melee final blows start health regeneration for you and nearby allies.

Freezing or suppressing a target reloads your equipped weapons and increases weapon stability, aim assist, and airborne effectiveness.

Defeating frozen or suppressed targets creates a Stasis Shard or Void Breach.
Picking up an Orb of Power grants either Bolt Charge, Restoration, Frost Armor, Woven Mail, or Overshield based on the damage type of your equipped Super.
Increases the size and damage of the burst when you shatter a Stasis crystal or frozen target, and increases the area of effect of Solar ignitions.
Grenade final blows cure you. Transcendence grenade final blows increase the strength of the effect.
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants Transcendence energy of the same type.
While you have an Arc, Solar, or Void buff, ability final blows grant bonus Darkness Transcendence energy.

Defeating targets with grenade final blows grants Volatile Rounds to your [Void] Void weapons. Defeating targets with powered melee final blows grants Unraveling Rounds to your [Strand] Strand weapons.
Your Void grenades weaken targets, and your Arc grenades jolt targets.
Rapidly defeating targets with Light or Darkness damage or Super final blows generates an Elemental pickup of the matching damage type.
Rapidly defeating targets with Light damage grants melee energy. Rapidly defeating targets with Darkness damage grants grenade energy.
While transcendent, your ability final blows explode.
While surrounded by combatants, you are more resistant to incoming damage. While transcendent, the effect is increased.
Defeating targets with Kinetic weapons grants you bonus Transcendence energy. Defeating targets with your Super grants you and nearby allies bonus Transcendence energy.
While you have an elemental buff, your class ability regenerates more quickly.
Landing rapid precision hits emits a severing blast from the target. While transcendent, the severing blast is bigger.
Your [Arc] Arc, [Solar] Solar, and [Void] Void abilities deal increased damage to targets afflicted with Darkness debuffs.

Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.

melee.d: Snap your fingers to create a fan of burning sparks that explode and scorch targets.
Send out a spiral of three explosive Solar energy blasts, scorching targets with each hit.

grenade.d: An explosive grenade that attaches to targets, damaging and moderately scorching them on detonation.
A grenade that cures allies on impact and creates an Orb of benevolent Solar Light, granting restoration to allies when picked up.
A grenade that unleashes bolts of damaging Solar Light at nearby targets and slightly scorches them.
A grenade that creates a flare of Solar Light that continuously damages and scorches targets trapped inside.
A grenade that explodes in a fiery burst and heavily scorches nearby targets.
An explosive grenade that sticks to surfaces and detonates when targets pass through its laser trigger, dealing damage and moderately scorching them.
A grenade that detonates on impact, releasing multiple drones that seek nearby targets. Each drone slightly scorches affected targets.
A grenade that sends forth a burning line of fire, dealing damage and scorching targets in its path.

aspects.d:
Activate your class ability to summon a [Solar] Solar mortar that lobs flaming projectiles at distant targets. Targets damaged by the mortar are scorched.

Hellion damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.

Your Healing, Solar, Firebolt, and Fusion Grenades have enhanced functionality.

Healing Grenade: Improves the strength of cure and restoration effects applied. Consuming a Healing Grenade with Heat Rises also applies restoration to nearby allies.

Solar Grenade: Increases linger duration. Periodically emits blobs of lava around its perimeter.

Firebolt Grenade: Increases target search radius and maximum target count.

Fusion Grenade: Explodes twice.

You can fire weapons, melee, and throw grenades while gliding.

[Grenade]  : Hold to consume your grenade, gaining Heat Rises and releasing a burst of healing energy that cures nearby allies. The strength of the burst is increased when a Healing Grenade is consumed.

Final blows while airborne increase the duration of Heat Rises and grant melee energy.

[Air Dodge]  : Dodge quickly while airborne.

While Heat Rises is active, you have an additional dodge.

While airborne, rapidly defeating targets with your Super or weapons cures you.

fragments.d: Powered melee attacks against combatants make you and nearby allies radiant.
Final blows with a Solar Super causes targets to ignite and creates a Firesprite.

Solar weapon final blows grant you and your allies increased health for a short duration. Stacks 3 times.

While Ember of Tempering is active, your weapons have increased airborne effectiveness, and your Solar weapon final blows create a Firesprite.
Your Solar ignitions spread scorch to affected targets.
Applying restoration, cure, or radiant to allies grants increased grenade, melee, and class ability regeneration for a short duration.
Your class ability recharges faster when you scorch targets.
Solar weapon or ability final blows extend the duration of restoration and radiant effects applied to you.
Your Solar Super projectiles have stronger target acquisition.
Radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.
Defeating targets with Solar ignitions grants grenade energy.
Your Solar ignitions have increased area of effect.
You apply more scorch stacks to targets.
Rapidly defeating multiple targets with Solar ignitions generates an Orb of Power.
Defeating scorched targets grants melee energy and creates a Firesprite.
Solar grenade final blows cure you.

When you revive an ally, you and other nearby allies gain restoration.

Picking up a Firesprite grants restoration.

super.d:
[Super]  : Conjure a hail of deadly woven needles.

After embedding themselves in the environment, the needles will re-weave into a host of Threadlings.

Threadlings you create will return to you and perch if they can't find any nearby targets. Damaging targets with your weapons or melee will send out perched Threadlings to attack.

classAbility.d: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.

Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.

movement.d: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.

melee.d: Sling a woven needle that will embed in your target, unraveling them. Activate your melee ability again to chain up to two additional attacks.

grenade.d: A grenade that bounces and releases multiple whirling threads, severing targets.

Weave a grappling hook, and quickly pull yourself forward. Grappling to a Tangle immediately recharges your grenade energy.

During and shortly after grappling, your melee attack deals area damage and unravels targets.
A thrown weapon of weighted Strand matter that detonates on impact, suspending targets and creating additional suspending subprojectiles.
A woven projectile that reweaves itself into Threadlings while in flight.

aspects.d:
[Air Dodge]  : Dodge while airborne to consume your melee energy and enter the weave, gaining damage resistance from combatants and players. Reactivate your air dodge or cast your Rift to exit the weave, generating Woven Mail for you and nearby allies.

While in the weave, your melee energy is drained and you generate perched Threadlings over time. Threadling hits generate ability energy.

Activate your class ability to weave three Threadlings and deploy any Threadlings you have perched.

Dealing damage and defeating targets generates perched Threadlings.

Your grapple, Shackle Grenade, Threadling Grenade, and Slicewire Grenade have enhanced functionality.

Your grapple melee spawns three Threadlings.

[Grenade]  : Hold to consume your Shackle Grenade and activate Weaver's Trance. Final blows while Weaver's Trance is active create a suspending detonation.

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Threadling Grenade, causing it to weave a Threadling Nest at the impact location that repeatedly spawns Threadlings. 

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Slicewire Grenade. The grenade's final detonation will launch submunitions and leave a Tangle in its wake.

Tangles you throw attach to targets and detonate into a suspending burst. Destroying a Tangle creates a suspending burst after a short delay.

Threadling final blows create Tangles or reduce your current Tangle cooldown.

fragments.d: Super final blows emit a suspending burst from the target.
Landing rapid precision hits emits a severing burst from the target.
Suspend, unravel, and sever effects applied to targets have increased duration.
Dealing damage generates grenade energy.
Powered melee final blows grant your [Strand] Strand weapons Unraveling Rounds.
Threadlings travel farther and deal additional damage.
Activating your grenade ability reloads your equipped weapon and grants bonus airborne effectiveness and handling for a short duration.
Finisher final blows create Threadlings.
Defeating suspended targets grants class ability energy.
Damaging targets with a Tangle grants melee energy.
[Strand] Strand weapon final blows have a chance to create a Threadling.
While you have Woven Mail, weapon final blows create a Tangle.
Picking up an Orb of Power grants Woven Mail.
Defeating suspended targets creates an Orb of Power.

heavyammofinder.h: Grants a 1.33x|1.66x|2x multiplier to all Heavy Ammo Meter progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

weftcutter.h: 20 Direct Hits on a target within 1 second of each other applies Sever for 10 seconds (15 seconds with Thread of Continuity) and grants you Woven Mail for 10 seconds.

chaoticexchanger.h:
Grants 20% Damage Resistance while overcharging a Void Grenade with Chaos Accelerant.
Overcharged Grenade Hits apply Weaken for 6 seconds and grant additional base grenade Regeneration Rate depending on the equipped grenade for 1.75 seconds.
• Axion: 5000% [4000%]
• Scatter: 3700% [2700%]
• Vortex: 3400% [2400%]
• Handheld Supernova: 2500% [2000%]
4 second cooldown between activations, which is removed on grenade usage. Grants between 50-60% Grenade energy per activation.
Vortex Grenades can proc twice if enemies get hit by the initial explosion and the last few ticks.

powerfulattraction.h:
Class Ability usage collects certain pickups within 12.5|18.5 meters with 1|2+ Mods equipped.
Applicable pickups:
• Orbs of Power
• Motes of Light in Gambit
• Crests in Supremacy
• Data Motes in Episode: Echoes activities

irongrip.h: Passively increases Stability by 20 but decreases Reload Speed by 20.
irongrip.e:
Passively increases Stability by 20 but decreases Reload Speed by 🡅15.
🡅 Reload Speed penalty is decreased by 5.

adrenalinejunkie.h:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Adrenaline Junkie for 4.5 seconds. Grenade Kills grant all 5 Stacks instantly even if the weapon is stowed.
Adrenaline Junkie benefits:
• 20 Handling
• 6.7%|13.3%|20%|26.6%|33.3% increased damage at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks
adrenalinejunkie.e:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Adrenaline Junkie for 🡅5 seconds. Grenade Kills grant all 5 Stacks instantly even if the weapon is stowed.
Adrenaline Junkie benefits:
• 20 Handling
• 6.7%|13.3%|20%|26.6%|33.3% increased damage at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

kineticweaponsurge.h:
Increases Kinetic Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

nanomunitions.h:
While within 15 meters of an ally:
Grants a stack of Nano-Munitions every 3 seconds. Maximum of 7 stacks.
Emptying this weapon's magazine consumes a stack to refill 25% of your magazine (rounded up). Consuming a stack restarts the timer for gaining new stacks.
Emptying the magazine of any other weapon consumes all stacks, with each stack refilling 25% of your Magazine (rounded up). Holding a weapon with an empty magazine also consumes these stacks.
Heat weapons confuse the perk in unexpected and inconsistent ways, and all stacks may be consumed at random while using one.

giftofthetraveler.h: Gain 15 Handling, 15 Reload Speed, and 2 Aim Assist for each stack of Gathering Light.

quicksilverstormcatalyst.h:
Converts this weapon's element into Strand damage.
Kills with Grenade Chaser grenades spawn a Tangle.

specialammoscout.h: Special Ammo bricks spawned from your ammo meter now appear for allies as well. These bricks contain 37%|67%|100% of the ammo a regular brick would have at 1|2|3 copies of the mod.

empoweringrift.h:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies within the rift:
• 20% [15%] Increased Damage (Empowering Buff)
• 260% [104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate
• 230% [92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
• Kills generate 15% Increased Ammo Meter Progress

healingrift.h:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Heals you and allies in the Rift for 40 [35] HP per second.
If at full health, the Rift grants 3 HP of Overshield per second, up to a 15 HP Overshield.
Standing in a friendly Healing Rift makes the game count you as having an active Overshield at all times.

dualloader.h: Reloading loads 1 additional round into the magazine at a time.
dualloader.e:
Reloading loads 🡅2 additional rounds into the magazine at a time.
🡅 Loads in 1 more round at a time.

thescientificmethod.h: Dealing damage grants 'Scientific Method' for 5 seconds, granting 35 Handling and maximized Movement Speed. Buff cannot be refreshed.

swordlogic.h:
Weapon Kills grant Stacks of Sword Logic.
The number of Stacks and the buff duration are tied to the highest Enemy Rank killed since activation:
• Minors: 1 Stack for 5.5 seconds
• Elites, Players: 2 Stacks for 7.5 seconds
• Players in their Super and Minibosses: 3 Stacks for 10.5 seconds
• Bosses: 4 Stacks for 15.5 seconds
Damage increase at 1|2|3|4 Stacks:
15% | 25% [15%] | 35% | 50%
Additional Kills refresh the buff duration to the duration tied to the highest Enemy Rank killed.
swordlogic.e:
Weapon Kills grant Stacks of Sword Logic.
The number of Stacks and the buff duration are tied to the highest Enemy Rank killed since activation:
• Minors: 1 Stack for 🡅6.5 seconds
• Elites, Players: 2 Stacks for 🡅8.5 seconds
• Players in their Super and Minibosses: 3 Stacks for 🡅11.5 seconds
• Bosses: 4 Stacks for 🡅16.5 seconds
Damage increase at 1|2|3|4 Stacks:
15% | 25% [15%] | 35% | 50%
Additional Kills refresh the buff duration to the duration tied to the highest Enemy Rank killed.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

therightchoice.h:
Counts as a "Dealer's Choice" origin trait weapon, but does not benefit from the trait itself.
Every 7th shot in the magazine deals 252.52% [5%] increased damage, has 50% increased Auto Aim cone size, and ricochets to the nearest target within an 8 [5] meter radius.

reaper.h:
The next Weapon Kill within 10 seconds of using your Class Ability spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)
10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

openingshot.h:
Grants the following benefits for your first shot (of the burst):
• 20 Aim Assist and 25 Range
• 5% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
Special weapons only receive 50% of the benefits. Stats are rounded up.
Firing the weapon prevents the perk from activating for 3 seconds.
openingshot.e:
Grants the following benefits for your first shot (of the burst):
• 🡅25 Aim Assist and 🡅30 Range
• 5% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
Special weapons only receive 50% of the benefits. Stats are rounded up.
Firing the weapon prevents the perk from activating for 3 seconds.
🡅 Grants 5 more Aim Assist and Range.

shieldbreakcharge.h: Breaking a Combatant Shield with the matching Elemental Damage Type grants 1 Stack of Armor Charge.

cqcopticshigh.h:
Passively increases Zoom by 1.
Increasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Increased Magnification
• Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Decreased Absolute Recoil
• Narrowed Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)

solarscavenger.h:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Solar Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

gravitywell.h:
Finishing a reload picks up all Ammo Bricks within 15 meters.
Also works on Motes and Crests.

fleetfooted.h:
Dealing damage grants 15 Airborne Effectiveness and ?% increased Movement Speed for 5 seconds.
Scoring a Weapon Kill increases this to 30 Airborne Effectiveness and ?% increased Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Weapon damage refreshes buff duration.

facetofdefiance.h:
Finishers trigger an Elemental explosion that deals up to 135 Super-Matching Elemental Damage and applies a Super-Matching Elemental Debuff in a ? meter radius.
Elemental Debuffs applied:
• Arc: Jolt
• Solar: x40 Scorch
• Void: Volatile
• Stasis: x? Slow for ? seconds
• Strand: Sever for ? seconds

weightededge.h:
When the magazine has at least 1 round loaded, Glaive Melee Attacks deal 50% increased damage and apply 40 Slow for 4 [1.5] seconds (8 [1.5] with Whisper of Durance).
Bosses only receive 20% increased damage.

finalwarningcatalyst.h:
Grants 10% increased damage to marked targets. Minibosses and Bosses only receive 5% more damage.
Hits against marked Minors and Elites|Minibosses and Bosses have an 85%|25% chance to refund one ammo into the magazine.

psychohack.h:
Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.
Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.
Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

onethousandvoicescatalyst.h:
I gain 30 Stability and 20 Ammo Generation.
Each of my detonations release a Taken Seeker which aggressively tracks and burrows into nearby targets, dealing 22 ticks of damage, one tick every 0.25 seconds, for 5.65 seconds.
My Taken Seekers can stun Overload Champions.
My foes can be afflicted by up to 5 seekers at once, and Blighted Enemies (directly impacted by Witherhoard) take 100% increased tick damage.
I do not interact with Malfeasance or Wish-Ender.
▛ Most of those who bargain with me do not win... ▟

hellion.h:
Casting your Class Ability grants 'Hellion' for 20 seconds.
Hellion fires Scorching projectiles every 1.35 seconds up to a distance of 32 meters, and inflict 30 Scorch per hit in a 4 meter radius (40 Scorch with Ember of Ashes).
Hellion projectiles count as a Grenade Ability and are buffed by, and trigger, grenade-specific effects. However, Scorch and Ignitions sourced by Hellion itself do not scale.

touchofflame.h:
Enhances your Healing, Firebolt, Solar, and Fusion Grenade Abilities:
• Healing Grenades grant Cure x2 and Restoration x2 for 4 seconds (6 with Ember of Solace)
• Firebolt Grenades gain 50% increased search radius (8🠚12 Meters) and targets 5 enemies (up from 4).
• Solar Grenades last 2 seconds longer and release 'Molten Lava Orbs' that deal additional damage.
• Fusion Grenades detonate a second time after 0.5 seconds, dealing additional damage in an 8 meter radius.

heatrises.h:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness. Allows you to use your weapons and abilities while gliding.
Kills while Airborne grant Melee Energy based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 20%
• Elites: 25%
• Minibosses: 35%
• Bosses and Players: 50%
Hold [Grenade] to consume it, activating 'Heat Rises' for 15 seconds, and grant Healing to you and allies within a 9 meter radius based on what was consumed.
Consuming a Healing Grenade grants Cure x3. If Touch of Flame is equipped, this also grants Restoration x1 for 4 seconds.
Consuming a Song of Flame Wisp grants Cure x3 and Restoration x2 for 4 seconds.
Restoration effects are extended to 6 seconds with Ember of Solace. All other grenades grant Cure x2.
Heat Rises grants 50 Airborne Effectiveness and effectively infinite Glide flight time, along with improved base movement capabilities of your equipped Glide. Enemy combatants are less accurate while Heat Rises is active.
Scoring kills while Airborne extends Heat Rises, up to a maximum of 30 seconds based off Combatant Rank:
• Minors and Players: 5 seconds
• Elites and Minibosses: 10 seconds
• Bosses: 15 Seconds

icarusdash.h:
While Airborne, pressing [Air Move] performs a horizonal dash that propels you 8 meters towards the input direction before entering a 4 second cooldown.
While Heat Rises or Song of Flame is active, gain an additional charge of Icarus Dash before entering a 5 second cooldown (currently only works in Song of Flame while using Incinerator Snap). Both charges are refilled per cooldown period.
Icarus Dash can be used infinitely during Daybreak at the cost of 4.2% super energy per use.
While Airborne, Weapon or Super Kills within 5 seconds of each grants Cure x1. Activation Progress is based on Combatant Rank:
• Minor: 34%
• Elite: 67%
• Bosses: 100%
• Players: 67%

empoweredfinish.h: Finishers with no active Armor Charge Stacks grant 1 Stack of Armor Charge.

rangedweapon.h:
Deals 50% increased damage to PvE Combatant Shields and 200% increased damage to Barrier Champion shields.
Melee Hits can discharge Bolt Charge stacks.
Tapping [Heavy Attack] throws your blade up to 50 meters away, seeking up to 3 enemies before returning. Blade deals 945 [174] damage to each target and 80% reduced damage while returning. Pressing [Light Attack] recalls the blade early.
Holding [Heavy Attack] throws your blade 20 meters forward in a straight unguided path and increases its damage by 100%.
With Gyro Core Equipped: Thrown Blade Hits apply elemental effects matching your subclass:
• Grants x1 Bolt Charge
• 35? Scorch (50? with Ember of Ashes). Stacks vary? between the two heavy attacks
• Weakens for 6 seconds
• 50 Slow for 4 seconds (8 with Whisper of Durance). Stacks vary? between the two heavy attacks
• Severs for 10 seconds (15 with Thread of Continuity)

hungeringquarrel.h: Fires two Void Bolts that heal on hit for 11 HP each.

onslaught.h:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Onslaught' for 4.5 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Benefits at 1|2|3 Stacks of Onslaught:
• 16.7% | 28.6% | 37.5% decreased Firing Delay
• 15 | 25 | 35 Reload Speed
onslaught.e:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Onslaught' for 🡅5 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Benefits at 1|2|3 Stacks of Onslaught:
• 16.7% | 28.6% | 37.5% decreased Firing Delay
• 15 | 25 | 35 Reload Speed
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5? seconds.

strandloader.h:
Grants the following to Strand Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

arctargeting.h:
Grants the following to Arc Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

voidstranddualsiphon.h:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Void or Strand Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

reaperstithe.h:
Grants stacks of 'Reaper's Tithe' based on the number of simultaneously killed enemies. Maximum of 4 stacks. (e.g. triple kill ⇒ 3 stacks)
'Reaper's Tithe' grants 20%|30%|40% increased damage for 15 seconds at 2|3|4 stacks (1st stack does not exist). Timer only starts after firing.
Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration by 6 seconds, but not beyond the initial 15-second duration.
Scoring a higher number of simultaneous Kills than the currently active stack count will not "upgrade" the buff.
reaperstithe.e:
Grants stacks of 'Reaper's Tithe' based on the number of simultaneously killed enemies. Maximum of 4 stacks. (e.g. triple kill ⇒ 3 stacks)
'Reaper's Tithe' grants 20%|30%|40% increased damage for 🡅17 seconds at 2|3|4 stacks (1st stack does not exist). Timer only starts after firing.
Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration by 6 seconds, but not beyond the initial 🡅17-second duration.
Scoring a higher number of simultaneous Kills than the currently active stack count will not "upgrade" the buff.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 2 seconds.

thedance.h:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness to Primary Weapons.
Grants the following benefits while a Primary Weapon is readied and not Aiming Down Sights:
• 30 Mobility
• 5 Range and 30? Stability
• 70% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 2 degrees increased Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 20% increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance
DMT, Last Word, and Tommy's Matchbook are uniquely tuned and do not receive as significant of a benefit.
Primary Weapon Kills grant Class Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: 20%
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
At full Class Ability energy, scoring multiple Primary Weapon Kills within 6 seconds of each grants an additional Class Ability Charge. Maximum of 2 extra charges.
Activation progress granted by Enemy Rank:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: 100%

runnethover.h:
While within 15 meters of allies:
• Finishing a reload overfills the Magazine from reserves by 10% of the Base Magazine Capacity (rounded up) for each ally
• Bows receive 7.5%|15%|17.5%|20%|25% decreased Draw Time for 1|2|3|4|5+? allies
• Swords receive increased Charge Rate

hierarchyofneedscatalyst.h:
Deploying a Guidance Ring or Guidance Seeker Hits grants the following benefits for 5 seconds:
• 40% reduced Hip-Fire Accuracy Cone
• 50% decreased Draw Time
• 100 Reload Speed
• ?% decreased Reload Animation Duration

headstone.h:
Precision Kills create a Large Stasis Crystal at the target's location.
Tier 1-2 Minor and Tier 1 Elite Combatants only spawn a Medium Stasis Crystal.
Creating 5 Crystals within ? seconds prevents the perk from activating for 5 seconds.
headstone.e:
Precision Kills create a Large Stasis Crystal at the target's location.
Creating 5 Crystals within ? seconds prevents the perk from activating for 5 seconds.
🡅 Low-tier enemy kills also spawn a Large Stasis Crystal instead of a Medium one.

facetofblessing.h:
Melee Kills start health regeneration.
While Transcendent, this also applies to allies within ? meters.

facetofcommand.h:
Freezing or Suppressing an enemy refills your readied weapon's magazine from reserves and grants 20? Stability, ? Aim Assist, and 40 Airborne Effectiveness for 11 seconds.
4 second cooldown between activations.
Killing Frozen or Suppressed Enemies spawns a Stasis Shard or Void Breach respectively.

facetofpurpose.h:
Collecting Orbs of Power grants Elemental buffs based on your equipped Super's element:
• Arc: 1 Bolt Charge Stack
• Solar: Restoration x1 for 5 seconds
• Void: 22.5 HP Overshield for 5 seconds
• Stasis: 2 Frost Armor Stacks for 9 seconds
• Strand: Woven Mail for 5 seconds

facetofruin.h:
Ignitions have a 25% increased blast radius.
Shattering enemies or destroying Crystals creates an additional damage instance, dealing up to 25 [9] damage in a 10 [8] meter radius.
Damage falls off to 17 [4] damage at the edge of the radius.

facetofmending.h:
Grenade Ability Kills grant you Cure x1.
Prismatic Grenade Kills grant you Cure x2.

facetofhonor.h:
Collecting Elemental Pickups or destroying a Tangle grants additional Transcendence Energy of the matching alignment:
• Ionic Traces, Firesprites, Void Breaches: 7.5% Light Transcendence Energy
• Stasis Shards: 5% Darkness Transcendence Energy
• Tangles: 10% Darkness Transcendence Energy

facetofsacrifice.h: Ability Kills with an active Arc, Solar, or Void Elemental buff grant an additional 1% [?%] Darkness Transcendence Energy.

facetofbravery.h:
Grenade Kills grant Volatile Rounds to Void Weapons for 11 [7.5] seconds.
Powered Melee Kills (including Knockout) grant Unraveling Rounds to Strand Weapons for 11 [7.5] seconds.

facetofdominance.h:
Void Grenade Ability damage applies Weaken for 6 [?] seconds.
Arc Grenade Ability damage applies Jolt.

facetofawakening.h:
Scoring a Super Kill or Killing 3 enemies with Elemental Damage within 6 seconds of each spawns an Elemental Pickup.
The type of Elemental Pickup is determined by the Damage Type of the final Kill.
5 second cooldown between spawning the same Pickup again. Spawned Tangles share the 12 second global spawn cooldown with the Fragment.
Kills with the element of the spawned Pickup while the cooldown is active do not count towards spawning another Elemental Pickup.
Elemental Pickups include Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, Tangles, and Void Breaches.

dynamiccharge.h:
Precision Hits and Kills grant one stack of 'Dynamic Charge'. Maximum of 15 stacks.
Holding [Reload] refills the magazine based on the number of stacks and converts them into 'Revolution' stacks. Switching modes again removes all stacks.
Revolution stacks remain ready until fired, after which point they last 10 seconds. Arc Seekers gain 30% [Varying] increased damage per stack of Revolution, up to 450% increased damage.
Arc Seekers also gain a non-linear increase to their splash radius, granting 33%|233% increased splash radius at x10|x20 Stacks (up to 4|7 meters in radius).
While Revolution's timer is active, Arc Seekers generate x2 Bolt Charge for each hit and gain the ability to discharge Bolt Charge stacks. At or above 10 stacks of Revolution, hits generate x3 Bolt Charge.
Bolt Charge generation is unaffected by Spark of Frequency.
Review this exotic's intrinsic perk to learn a special note about the Bolt Charge behavior from this gun.

soulburn.h:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.
Landing two Frontal Blade hits within 2 seconds of each other, or scoring a Frontal Blade kill, heals you for 40 HP and grants one stack of 'Soulfire Charge'. Maximum of 6 stacks.
Firing this weapon consumes one stack of Soulfire Charge to apply Potent Corruption (poison) that increases in DOT over time.
Potent Corruption deals 65 [?] Kinetic damage once every 0.5 seconds for 10 seconds, ramping up in damage by 8.7% for each tick over 20 ticks, ending at 300 [?] damage on the final tick. In total, one application of Potent Corruption deals 2,985 [?] damage.
Frontal Blades deal 50% increased melee damage against corrupted (poisoned) enemies.

reversaloffortune.h: Missing twice within 6 seconds refills 1 round into the Magazine from thin air.

sleepersimulantcatalyst.h: Increases Reserves by 2 (14🠚16) and decreases Charge Time by 33% (1024🠚774) without reducing damage.

nanotechtracermissiles.h:
Scoring multiple Hits within 6 seconds of each fires a Tracking Rocket that matches the weapon's element.
Rockets deal 22.4 [14] Impact and 24 [15] Explosive damage on Hit and inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling. On non-primary weapons, the Rockets receive an additional damage increase.
% of magazine capacity as Hits required and the additional damage increase by weapon archetype:
• Hand Cannons, Pulse Rifles, Submachine Guns: 45% Magazine Capacity \\ 0% increased damage (Baseline)
• Sniper Rifles: 50%? \\ 100%
• Grenade Launchers: 30% \\ 25%
• Machine Guns: 25% \\ 50%
• Fusion Rifles, Shotguns: ?% \\ 150%
1 second cooldown after activation before further Hits provide activation progress again.

fortheempire.h: Deals 11% increased damage against Cabal enemies and pierces through Phalanx Shields and Cabal Shield Domes.

volatilebattery.h:
Sets the Magazine Size to 33, greatly exceeding that of any other fusion rifle.
▛ ...an energy cell pulling from multiple timelines, resulting in a charge surplus that can only be explained if the firing cycle began in... ▟

glacialguard.h:
Requires a Stasis Super Ability to be equipped. Overwrites Barricade Cooldown to a unique, faster, 70 second Base Cooldown class ability (~30 seconds at 100 Class Stat).
Scoring 2 Stasis Kills within 3 seconds of each grants a Stack of Frost Armor.
Restores 10 HP for each Stack of Frost Armor you gain from any source.
Replaces Barricade with Glacial Guard which has a cooldown matching Towering Barricade's. Does not work with Thruster.
On Glacial Guard Cast:
• Grants you maximum Frost Armor Stacks (restoring HP for each Stack gained)
• Applies 100 [40] Slow to enemies within ? meters

trappersambush.h:
While Airborne with full Class Ability Energy, activate [Air Move] to consume your Class Ability and quickly slam to the ground, dealing damage to all enemies within a 6? meter radius. Deals 50% increased damage in a 33?% bigger radius if you have a Void Buff (Devour, Overshield, Invisibility) active.
Grants 5 seconds (7 with Echo of Persistence) of Void Invisibility if cast while already Invisible.
Hits heal for ?HP, and kills grant Devour for 10 seconds (15 with Echo of Persistence).
When paired Vanishing Step Aspect:
Trapper's Ambush adopts its former functionality and drops a Void Smoke Cloud upon landing. Enemies hit by the detonation of the Smoke Cloud are Weakened for 10 [5] seconds, while allies are granted Void Invisibility for 6.5 seconds.
Trapper's Ambush triggers the effects of your equipped dodge upon consumption. Damage scales up to 65% increased damage at 200 Class Stat.

vanishingstep.h:
Replaces your Dodge Animation with a longer range, faster traveling side-step that grants Void Invisibility for 5 seconds (7 with Echo of Persistence).
This aspects grants additional functionality to Trapper's Ambush upon casting the air move (see Trapper's Ambush description).

stylishexecutioner.h:
Defeating a Void-Debuffed (Prismatic Only: Any Elementally Debuffed) target grants Void Invisibility for 8 seconds (11 with Echo of Persistence) and Truesight for 4 seconds.
Activating Stylish Executioner incurs a 2 [12] second cooldown.
While under the effect of Void Invisibility granted by Stylish Executioner, gain the following benefits for 0.? seconds after leaving Invisibility:
• 300% [20%] Increased Melee Damage
• Melee applies Weaken for 5 [2] seconds
• Melee Lunge Range is extended by ? meters
Powered Melee Abilities may benefit from this effect if they deal damage within the exit window.

ontheprowl.h:
Entering Void Invisibility, or going 12 seconds without having marked a combatant in PvE, marks a Non-Boss target within 45 [25] meters of you, prioritizing Minor combatants close to your reticle. Target remains marked indefinitely [15 seconds] until killed.
Defeating the marked target triggers a Void Smoke explosion at their death location and grants one stack of 'Successful Hunt' for 7 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.
Successful Hunt instantly grants ?% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability energy upon being earned, and additionally provides ? Stability, ? Reload Speed, and ?% decreased Reload Animation Speed for its duration.
Void Smoke lasts for 7 seconds, deals damage over time, and can trigger melee-associated effects. Enemies within are Disoriented and Weakened, while allies that enter are granted Void Invisibility for 5 seconds (7 seconds with Echo of Persistence).

halberdiersreach.h:
Glaive Melee Kills load 1 Ammo into the Magazine from reserves. Can overfill the Magazine up to double the normal capacity.
While within 15 meters of 3 enemies:
Grants 50 Reload Speed and 200% increased Glaive Melee Damage.
Glaive Projectile Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing up to 350 [101] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 4? meter radius.

ambush.h:
Grants the following benefits if you have not dealt or received damage in the last 5 seconds:
• 20 Range and 20 Handling
• 15% decreased Draw Time on Bows
• 10.78% increased damage against PvE Combatants. Linear Fusion Rifles only receive an 8.88% damage increase.
Deactivates 2 seconds after exchanging damage.

stasisdexterity.h:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Stasis Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

butterfly.h:
Aiming Down Sights for 1.5 seconds without firing causes your next kill to trigger an explosion matching the weapon's element within an 8 meter radius, experiencing a maximum of 30% damage falloff.
Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.
butterfly.e:
Aiming Down Sights for 🡅1.4 seconds without firing causes your next kill to trigger an explosion matching the weapon's element within an 8 meter radius, experiencing a maximum of 30% damage falloff.
Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.
🡅 Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.

lightningrod.h:
Precision Kills grant 'Lightning Rod'.
Lightning Rod arrows explode on impact and chain lightning in an 8 meter radius around their point of impact for 194 [50.3] damage each.

archerstempo.h:
Precision Hits decrease Draw Time by 25% for 3 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.
archerstempo.e:
Precision Hits decrease Draw Time by 25% for 🡅4 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

pulsemonitor.h:
Refills Magazine from reserves upon dropping to 30% Shield Health. Can activate while stowed.
Grants 50 Handling and a 0.95x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier while at or below 30% Shield Health.
Buff lingers for 1 second once the condition is no longer met.
pulsemonitor.e:
Refills Magazine from reserves upon dropping to 🡅35% Shield Health. Can activate while stowed.
Grants 50 Handling and a 0.95x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier while at or below 🡅35% Shield Health.
Buff lingers for 1 second once the condition is no longer met.
🡅 Activates with 5?% more Shield Health remaining.

paracausalshot.h:
On kill or Precision Hit, gain one stack of Paracausal Charge. Maximum of 7 stacks. Stacks are removed on reload or any full magazine refill.
Paracausal Charge grants increased damage against Combatants at 1|2|3|....|7| Stacks:
21%|36.5%|48%|55%|60%|63%|66%
Paracausal Charge turns into Paracausal Shot on the final round of the magazine. Buff is removed if stowed.
Paracausal Shot's damage bonus at 1|2|3|...|7| stacks:
PvE: 292%|300%|340%|425%|667%|1071%|1736%
PvP: 30%|33%|46%|80.5%|154%|288%|509%

snareweaver.h:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on Combatant Rank. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.
Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3
At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.
Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take 341 [5] damage and are Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.
5 second cooldown between Suspends on the same enemy.
Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.

hkkeprecisionframe.h: This weapon fires a small auto-tracking missile. Missiles lock onto targets when aimed.

themaster.h:
Rounds must be chambered after every shot. Animation can be sprint-cancelled as soon as the bolt is drawn in (at the 'clink'), allowing for an increased rate of fire.
Scoring a Precision Hit grants one stack of 'The Master' up to an infinite amount, with effective benefits ending after 20 stacks. Shots visually explode after 20 stacks with no added benefit.
Grants diminishing increases to Precision Damage across 1|2|3|....|20 stacks:
• Stacks 1-5: 16%|22%|27%|31%|35%
• Stacks 6-10: 38%|41%|44%|47%|49.5%
• Stacks 11-15: 52%|54%|56.5%|59%
• Stacks 16-20: 63%|64.5%|66%|68%|70%
Buff persists until death.

sundering.h:
Grants the following for 7 seconds upon breaking an enemy's shield or destroying a Vehicle or Construct:
• 40 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 0.9x Draw Time Multiplier

overclockedheatsink.h:
Passively grants 2% increased damage and 10 decreased Cooling Efficiency stat.
🡅 Passively grants 2 Handling.

soaringfang.h:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.
While grounded, hits grant 1.5% charge to your Anti-Grav Repulsors. Kills grant 10% charge.
Once you are above 3% charge, hits after being airborne for 0.5 seconds activate 'Hover Mode'. Hover Mode is disengaged by Holding [Reload], reaching 0% charge, or stowing the weapon.
Hover Mode removes all airborne accuracy penalties, reduces combatant accuracy (similar to Amplified's effects), and grants complete aerial movement at a speed of 5.5 meters per second.
Hover Mode starts at 3 seconds. Each hit restores 0.3 seconds to the timer. Timer cannot exceed 3 seconds.

osteostrigacatalyst.h:
Grants 30 Reload and 20 Stability.
Poison Kills instantly refill the magazine and can overfill it up to 300% total capacity.
0.5 second cooldown between activations.

apollonictangent.h:
While at 3 stacks, hip-firing a fully-drawn arrow spawns a Guidance Ring.
Guidance Ring lasts 20 seconds and will rotate in place to face you. Only one Guidance Ring per-guardian can exist at a time, but up to 3 Guidance Rings can exist across a fireteam. Each Guidance Ring can stack.
Firing any fully-drawn arrow through the Guidance Ring triggers several additional seeking projectiles, each dealing 192 [15] damage. Seekers gain 50% [15-20%] increased damage past 40 meters and have a maximum range of 80 meters. Precision hits with the fired arrow guide the seekers towards that enemy.
Each seeker applies 15 Scorch (20 with Ember of Ashes) and deals Weapon-Element Matching Explosive Damage in a 4 meter radius.
Guidance Rings grant their benefits to any Combat Bow, including Legendaries, Exotics, Heavy Crossbows, Shadowshot, and also Buried Bloodline.
Arrows fired by Hierarchy of Needs release three seekers, while most other bows release two. Casting Shadowshot: Deadfall releases six.

serviceofluzakucatalyst.h:
Teeming Nests can be harvested into a collectible Tangle after spawning 6 Threadlings. This destroys the nest.
These tangles ignore the global Tangle cooldown.

peregrinestrike.h:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness.
Grants Peregrine Strike after sprinting for 2 seconds and being airborne for 0.5 seconds. Buff is removed upon touching the ground.
Peregrine Strike increases the impact damage of Shoulder Charge Melee Abilities by 250%.
Against Minibosses, the buff is increased to 550% and refunds your Melee Ability charge on hit.
Shoulder Charge abilities: Seismic Strike, Hammer Strike, and Shield Bash
Provides no benefits when hitting Frozen enemies.

vanishingexecution.h:
Powered Melee Kills and Finishers grant Invisibility and restore 67 HP.
Invisibility Duration is based on Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 7 seconds
• Elites, Enemy Players: 10 seconds
• Minibosses and Bosses: 13 seconds
The duration of Invisibility granted by Finishers is 3 seconds longer. Echo of Persistence increases Invisibility duration by 41.5%.

reflectivevents.h:
Upon sliding after sprinting for at least 1.5 seconds with your Class Ability fully charged:
Projects a 180° frontal shield that reflects all incoming projectiles for 0.45 seconds.
Reflected projectiles deal 50% increased damage.
After shield deactivation, 2% Class Ability energy is drained for every point of damage reflected.
Currently partially bugged and does not drain Class Ability Energy for projectiles reflected at the end of your slide.

attritionorbs.h:
Scoring multiple Hits against enemies within 5 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8% Super Energy.
Does not require Direct Hits. Hit counter persists through stow.
Hit requirements for activation:
• Rocket Launchers: 2 hits
• Heavy Grenade Launchers: 3 Hits
• Wave-Frame Grenade Launchers: 4 hits
• Bows: 4 Hits
• Swords: 5 Hits
• Area-Denial Grenade Launchers: 26 Hits
• Others: 55% of Magazine Size rounded down + 1
Support Frame Auto Rifle healing round Hits on damaged allies count as 2 Hits.
attritionorbs.e:
Scoring multiple Hits against enemies within 5 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power that grants 🡅1.1% Super Energy.
Does not require Direct Hits. Hit counter persists through stow.
Hit requirements for activation:
• Rocket Launchers: 2 hits
• Heavy Grenade Launchers: 3 Hits
• Wave-Frame Grenade Launchers: 4 hits
• Bows: 4 Hits
• Swords: 5 Hits
• Area-Denial Grenade Launchers: 26 Hits
• Others: 55% of Magazine Size rounded down + 1
Support Frame Auto Rifle healing round Hits on damaged allies count as 2 Hits.
🡅 Spawned Orbs grant 37.5?% more Super Energy (0.8%⁠🠚⁠1.1?⁠%).

rapidhit.h:
"Buffed Hits" grant 1 Stack of Rapid Hit for 2 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
"Buffed Hits" refer to any "Yellow Number" Hits such as Precision Hits or Hits against debuffed targets.
Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2|12|14|18|25 Stability
• 5|30|35|42|60 Reload Speed
• 0.99x|0.96x|0.95x|0.945x|0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier
rapidhit.e:
"Buffed Hits" grant 1 Stack of Rapid Hit for 2 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
"Buffed Hits" refer to any "Yellow Number" Hits such as Precision Hits or Hits against debuffed targets.
Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2|12|14|18|25 Stability
• 5|30|35|42|60 Reload Speed
• 0.99x|0.96x|0.95x|0.945x|0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier
🡅 Stronger Effect.

radiolariatransposer.h:
Scoring multiple Weapon Kills within 8 seconds of each causes your last-killed target to explode and create a Radiolaria Pool at their location. Stowing the weapon resets the Kill Counter.
Explosion deals up to 67.5 [?] damage in a 3? meter radius.
Radiolaria Pool information:
• Deals 15 [?] Arc damage every 0.65 seconds
• Lasts for ? seconds (3? damage ticks)
• Inherits the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling and any weapon damage buffs
Activation Progress based on Enemy Rank:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: ?%

weavewalk.h:
While Airborne with at least one full Melee Charge, pressing [Air Move] activates Weavewalk and consumes 20% Melee Ability Energy.
While Weavewalk is active, your Melee Energy drains at a rate of 25% per second, and you generate a Perched Threadling every 0.5 seconds.
Weavewalk grants 90% Damage Resistance against Combatants and Players, and functionally grants the effects of Void Invisibility, preventing enemy combatants from engaging you.
You are unable to interact with the world while Weavewalk is active. This includes reviving other Players, collecting ammo bricks, or picking up Orbs of Power. Threadlings, Arc Souls, and No Time To Explain's 'Time-Slip Portal' deal 50% decreased damage while Weavewalk is active.
Exiting Weavewalk grants Woven Mail based on the duration it was active, granting 2 to 20 seconds of Woven Mail.

weaverscall.h:
Dealing damage to enemies gradually generates 'Perched' Threadlings at a maxium rate of one Threadling every 2 seconds.
Scoring kills also generate progress towards creating a Perched Threadling based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors, Elites, and Minibosses: 33%
• Players: 67%
• Bosses: 100%
Casting your Class Ability creates three Threadlings and simultaneously deploys all Perched Threadlings.
Threadlings grant 10% Class Ability Energy per hit.

mindspuninvocation.h:
Enhances your Strand Grenade abilities:
• Grapple Melees create 3 Threadlings on hit
• Threadling Grenade can be charged by holding [Grenade] to create a Threadling Nest on impact, which spawns 3 Threadlings instantly and then one additional Threadling every 5 seconds for 17.5 seconds.
• Shackle Grenade can be consumed by holding [Grenade], granting 'Weaver's Trance' for 25 seconds. Kills while Weaver's Trance is active trigger a ? meter radius explosion around the target that Suspends enemies for 6? seconds
• Slicewire Grenade can be charged by holding [Grenade] to drop 4 additional explosion submunitions, and ends with the creation of a Tangle (ignores global cooldowns)

thewanderer.h:
Threadling Kills can now spawn a Tangle, and reduce Tangle cooldown by 1 second per kill.
Shooting a Tangle creates a delayed explosion that detonates after ? seconds, Suspending all enemies hit for 7 seconds.
Thrown Tangles are unaffected by gravity and aggressively seek targets, attaching to them and detonating after ? seconds. These detonations Suspend enemies in a ? meter radius for 7 seconds.

nobledeeds.h:
Assisting Allies by Reviving, Healing, Empowering, or granting Subclass Buffs to them grants 10 Stacks of Noble Deeds. Maximum of 10 Stacks.
Can be triggered even while the weapon is stowed.
Kills consume 1 [2] Stacks of Noble Deeds.
Grants 🡅 35? Handling and 🡅 35? Reload Speed while you have active Stacks. Swords receive 🡅 25? Charge Rate instead.

firmlyplanted.h:
While Crouched:
• 30 Handling and 20 Stability
• -40% Accuracy Cone Size
• -17% Accuracy Cone Growth
• -80% horizontal Recoil
Effects are halved on Fusion Rifles (decimals are rounded up).
firmlyplanted.e:
While Crouched:
• 🡅35 Handling and 🡅25 Stability
• -40% Accuracy Cone Size
• -17% Accuracy Cone Growth
• -80% horizontal Recoil
Effects are halved on Fusion Rifles (decimals are rounded up).
🡅 Grants 5 more Handling and Stability.

whitenail.h: Landing 3 Precision Hits within 2.5 seconds of each refills the magazine. Pulls 2 shots from reserves and generates 1 ammo from thin air.

temporalalignmentrefit.h:
Grants 20% increased damage for 16 seconds upon activating both Arc and Stasis Overcharge one after another.
No time limit between the two activations.

transcendentzenrefit.h:
Grants the Transcendent Moment trait:
Weapon Kills grant stat benefits based on the weapon's elemental alignment for ? seconds.
Light Alignment grants ? Stability and ? Handling.
Dark Alignment grants ? Range and ? Aim Assist.
Kills while Transcendent activate both bonuses.
Light Alignment: Arc, Solar, Void
Darkness Alignment: Stasis, Strand

subsistencerefit.h:
Grants the Subsistence trait:
Weapon Kills refill 10% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves.
Submachine Gun and Auto Rifle Kills refill 17% of the magazine.

rapidhitrefit.h:
Grants the Rapid Hit trait:
"Buffed Hits" grant 1 Stack of Rapid Hit for 2 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
"Buffed Hits" refer to any "Yellow Number" Hits such as Precision Hits or Hits against debuffed targets.
Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2|12|14|18|25 Stability
• 5|30|35|42|60 Reload Speed
• 0.99x|0.96x|0.95x|0.945x|0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier

unflinchingharmonicaim.h:
While Aiming Down Sights with Weapons matching your Subclass Element:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

releasethewolves.h:
While Aiming Down Sights, fires in 5 round bursts.
While Hip-Firing, Lord of Wolves becomes fully-automatic and grants the following benefits:
• 60% increased Rate of Fire
• 200% increased Accuracy Cone Size
• ? reduced Range
• 39% increased bodyshot damage and 20% increased precision damage. Bosses take 10% increased bodyshot damage and receive no increase to precision damage.

delicatetuning.h:
Grants linearly decreasing benefits as Weapon Heat increases from 0% to 50%:
• 20 to 10 Range
• ? to ? Handling
• ? to ? decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
delicatetuning.e:
Grants linearly decreasing benefits as Weapon Heat increases from 0% to 50%:
• 🡅22 to 🡅11 Range
• ? to ? Handling
• ? to ? decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
🡅 Stat Benefits are increased by 10%.

unflinchingarcaim.h:
While Aiming Down Sights with Arc Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

cosmology.h:
Kills throw enemies ? meters back before triggering a Void Explosion. Void Explosions deal 470 [?] damage in a 7 meter radius and spawn two seeking orbs, each dealing 51 [20] damage. Explosion falls to 0% damage at the edge of its blast radius.
Void Explosion kills can trigger additional Void Explosions.

solartargeting.h:
Grants the following to Solar Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

closethegap.h:
Hits against Suspended enemies inflicts 20 Scorch (30 with Ember of Ashes).
Kills spawn a Firesprite.
After picking up a Firesprite, hold [Reload] to enable a Charged Laser. Charged Laser takes 0.5 seconds to charge, at which point it fires for 0.93 seconds at 1000 RPM and hits 15 times.

stasisholster.h:
After stowing Stasis Weapons:
